newsitem.title: USA: MBIA qualifies 15 muni issues for insurance.
newsitem.headline: MBIA qualifies 15 muni issues for insurance.

text.p: MBIA Insurance Corp said Tuesday it qualified for bond insurance the following 15 municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today:
--Redding School District, Calif., $7.215 million general obligation bonds.
--Regional School District No 15, Conn., $8 million GOs.
--Hiawatha, Iowa, $1.3 million GOs.
--Dekalb East Community School District, Ind., $1.025 million GOs.
--Gibson County Redevelopment Authority, Ind., $3.7 million Economic Development lease bonds, Direct Purchase
--Lafayette, La., $26 million public improvement bonds.
--Forest Lake, ISD No 831, Minn., $6.1 million GOs.
--Mc Intosh ISD No 2609, Minn $7.9 million GOs.
--Sherburne County, Minn., Housing $6 million Revenue bonds.
--High Point, N.C., $7 million Public Improvement bonds
--McIntosh ISD No 2609, Minn $7.9 million GOs.
--Sherburne County, Minn., Housing $6 million Revenue bonds.
--High Point, N.C., $7 million Public Improvement bonds
--Pineville, N.C., $1.065 million Refunding bonds
--Campbell-Savona Community School District, N.Y. $3.9 million GOs.
--Milton Area School District, Pa., $9.995 million GOs
--Brownsville, Texas, $5.01 million tax and revenue bonds.
--Brownsville, Texas, $2.185 million GOs.
--U.S. Municipal Desk, 212-859-1650
